behavior: NVDA 18721 reported a live-region problem, but maintainers could not reproduce it on Edge 144 and closed it works-for-me on 2026-01-08; it is not evidence of universal reliability or failure.
decision: Use persistent role=status for nonurgent updates and role=alert only for urgent interruptions; test exact browser/AT pairs and avoid timer workarounds from one report.

behavior: JAWS 469 reports duplicate speech when a textarea aria-describedby references a live character counter; the same content was heard through description and live announcement paths.
decision: Do not make the same frequently updated text both a focused description and a live region; choose one announcement path and deduplicate messages.

behavior: WAI-ARIA defines status as polite/atomic and alert as assertive/atomic; it does not specify or certify TalkBack speech timing.
decision: Use persistent status/alert containers mounted before text changes; verify actual TalkBack output rather than adding redundant regions.

behavior: TetraLogical's published tests explain that initial-content behavior and insertion/update timing vary; current announcement, duplication, and interruption behavior remain unmeasured.
decision: Prime an empty persistent region before updating its text and test one announcement; do not claim a universal timer or initial-content workaround.
